summary: The PR addresses the issue of unnecessary SQL generation for AlterField operations on SQLite when changing choices, but introduces some minor issues.

issues.description: The addition of `choices` to `non_db_attrs` in `django/db/models/fields/__init__.py` is specific to this issue and could be considered a slight scope creep. It might be better to handle this attribute specifically within the `_field_should_be_altered` method.
There is no update to the documentation or comments to explain why `choices` is now included in `non_db_attrs`. Adding a comment or updating the docstring would improve clarity.
